$comment: 语法大厅 G50（V0.9 P4 精修层收官，三笔债之三，全 50 课终点）。比喻锚点：最后一次总排练：把老毛病一次点完。以备考知识库 6.5 节 8 类中式错误表为底升级 16 类，保持三色分区逻辑（会挡意思/不挡但考/不挡也不考）；保留原表最关键的判断：只打红区，灰区（三单-s、单复数）不反复纠正——官方满分范文里就有这类错照样 15/15（原创等效表述）。echo 段承担全套暗线收束，平静收尾。全部内容原创。
title: 中式英语专项（16 类总表）
metaphor: 最后一次总排练：把老毛病一次点完
ketNote: 老实说：这一课不是新考点，是全套课程的总排练。KET 备考中心那张 8 类错误表管 KET 够用；这张 16 类总表是为初中/PET 打底。不用焦虑，学到就是赚到。

sections.essence: 16 类老毛病三色点名：红区四类立即改，黄区九类按考点练，灰区三类别打断。
sections.why: KET 备考中心里有一张 8 类中式错误表，那是为 KET 准备的急救包。从基石层一路练到进阶层，新的毛病也陆续露头：从句忘了坐正、转述忘了退一步、enjoy 后面接了 to do、被动丢了 be……今天把新老毛病合成一张 16 类总表，作为 50 课的最后一次总排练。三色分区的逻辑一个字不改：红区是「会挡住意思」的——听的人会误解或听不懂，必须立即改；黄区是「不挡意思但考试要考」的——为分数练，练熟即可，不必上纲上线；灰区是「不挡意思也几乎不考」的——第三人称 -s、单复数这类，只有内行才注意，交流毫发无损。最关键的那条判断也原样保留：只打红区。灰区的错不要反复纠正——那是把孩子说到不敢开口最快的办法，而回报接近零。
sections.metaphorStory: 首演前夜，银帆乐队最后一次总排练。指挥没有教任何新曲子，只拿着三色便签在谱架间走了一圈。红色便签贴了四张：「这几处会让观众听不懂——今晚必须改。」黄色便签贴了九张：「这几处观众听不出来，但评委会扣分——按曲目单各自加练。」还剩三张灰色的，指挥捏在手里没贴出去。学徒问为什么，指挥说：「这三处只有坐在第一排的老乐师才听得出来，观众毫无感觉。要是我为这个喊停，全团的士气比这三个音值钱得多。」他顿了顿：「我见过评委给有小瑕疵的演出打满分——因为音乐是完整的、动人的。记住：排练的目标从来不是零错误，是让观众听懂你要说的话。」

cards.detail: 问句不请起拍手势，听的人不知道你在提问（G12）。
cards.example: You like music? → Do you like music?

cards.detail: 英语的等号不能省——形容词前必须有 be（G04）。
cards.example: I very happy. → I am very happy.

cards.detail: 讲故事半路转调，听的人时间线全乱（G15）。
cards.example: Yesterday he sees a dog and ran. → saw ... ran

cards.detail: 该换灯不换灯，谁对谁做的全反了（G29）。
cards.example: The fish ate. → The fish was eaten.

cards.detail: 点/面/盒子拿错（G11）——通常不挡意思，但考试直接考。
台上台下的身份牌拿反（G03）。
cards.example: Me and Tom went out. → Tom and I went out.

cards.detail: 单数可数名词不能光着上台（G02）。
cards.example: I have book. → I have a book.

cards.detail: 一句只要一个领队——because 和 so 只能留一个（G20/G36）。
cards.example: Because it rained, so we stayed in. → 去掉 so

cards.detail: 进了座位还举着问句手势（G33）。
cards.example: I don't know where is he. → where he is

cards.detail: 主句在过去，从句的将来要退成 would（G40/G47）。
cards.example: He said he will come. → he would come

cards.detail: 点菜单拿错——enjoy 只收箱，decide 只点号（G46）。
very 只修饰形容词副词——动词的「很」用 very much 收尾。
cards.example: I very like it. → I like it very much.

cards.rule: 🟡 13 · There be 与 have 杂交
cards.detail: 报幕用 There is/are，拥有用 sb has——两句式不能焊在一起（G05）。
cards.example: There has a book on the desk. → There is a book

cards.detail: 不挡意思、写作里也只算小瑕疵——记在本上，别当场打断。
cards.example: He go to school early. → goes

cards.detail: 同上——意思毫发无损，慢慢磨（G01/G19）。
cards.example: three book / many water → three books / much water

cards.detail: 词义里已含的成分再说一遍——不挡意思，初中也几乎不考。
cards.example: return back → return ／ discuss about → discuss

basic.en: Do you often come here by bike?
basic.cn: 你常骑车来这儿吗？（红1 改对：起拍手势 Do 到位）

basic.en: My little sister is afraid of thunder.
basic.cn: 我妹妹怕打雷。（红2 改对：be 在场）

basic.en: Last night I heard a noise, got up and looked outside.
basic.cn: 昨晚我听到响声，起床朝外看。（红3 改对：全程过去格）

basic.en: All the mooncakes were eaten before nine.
basic.cn: 月饼九点前就被吃光了。（红4 改对：聚光灯换对了）

basic.en: The window was broken, so Dad fixed it.
basic.cn: 窗户破了，爸爸把它修好了。（红4：被动主动各归各位）

mid.en: We have a picnic on the first Sunday of May.
mid.cn: 五月的第一个周日我们去野餐。（黄5：日子用 on）

mid.en: Lily and I are in charge of the class library.
mid.cn: 莉莉和我负责班级图书角。（黄6：主语位用 I，还把对方放前面）

mid.en: Because the bus was late, we ran to school.
mid.cn: 因为公交晚点，我们跑着去学校。（黄8：so 已让位）

mid.en: Could you tell me how much the ticket costs?
mid.cn: 请问票价多少？（黄9：从句坐正）

mid.en: She said she would show us her stamp collection.
mid.cn: 她说她会给我们看集邮册。（黄10：will 退成 would）

trap.en: He like noodles very much.（有小错，但该不该打断？）
trap.note: 三单 -s 丢了——灰区。意思零损失，记在本上就好，不当场打断。

trap.en: I bought three apple and some waters.（灰区双错）
trap.cn: 我买了三个苹果和一些水。
trap.note: 单复数错两处——听的人照样全懂。灰区的错，攒着慢慢磨。

trap.en: I like this song very much.
trap.note: 「很喜欢」的正确落点——very much 在句尾，very 不压在 like 上。

trap.en: There is a new bookshop near the station.
trap.note: 报幕用 There is——别跟 have 杂交成 There has。

trap.en: We finished cleaning and decided to have a rest.
trap.cn: 我们打扫完，决定歇一会儿。
trap.note: finish 收箱、decide 点号——黄11 的两张菜单一句用对。

trap.en: Please return the ruler to me after class.
trap.note: return 自带「回」——不再加 back；加了也只是灰区冗余，不必大惊小怪。

redBlack.bad: You finish your homework?（想问：你写完了吗）
redBlack.good: Have you finished your homework? / Did you finish your homework?
redBlack.why: 红1：不请助动词、语序不动，问意送不出去——听的人以为你在陈述。

redBlack.bad: My grandpa very strict about study.
redBlack.good: My grandpa is very strict about study.
redBlack.why: 红2：等号 be 一丢，句子当场散架——中文「爷爷很严」不用「是」，英语必须有。

redBlack.bad: Last Sunday we go to the beach and swam all afternoon.
redBlack.good: Last Sunday we went to the beach and swam all afternoon.
redBlack.why: 红3：叙事半路转调——go 和 swam 一今一昔，听的人时间线断裂。

redBlack.bad: My ice cream ate, so I cried.（想说：冰激凌被吃了）
redBlack.good: My ice cream was eaten, so I cried.
redBlack.why: 红4：不换灯，冰激凌成了吃东西的一方——谁吃谁全反。

redBlack.bad: We have an English test in Friday morning.
redBlack.good: We have an English test on Friday morning.
redBlack.why: 黄5：具体某天的早上是「面」——用 on（G11 的点面盒）。

redBlack.bad: Me and my cousin built a sandcastle.
redBlack.good: My cousin and I built a sandcastle.
redBlack.why: 黄6：主语位用 I，并把对方放前面——考试和礼貌一起到位。

redBlack.bad: Although it was cold, but we still went camping.
redBlack.good: Although it was cold, we still went camping.
redBlack.why: 黄8：although 和 but 一山不容二虎——领队只留一个。

redBlack.bad: Do you know when does the museum open?
redBlack.good: Do you know when the museum opens?
redBlack.why: 黄9：从句进了座位要坐正——does 的手势要收回去。

redBlack.bad: The coach told us the match will start at nine that day.
redBlack.good: The coach told us the match would start at nine that day.
redBlack.why: 黄10：told 站在过去——从句的 will 跟着退成 would。

redBlack.bad: I very miss my old classmates.
redBlack.good: I miss my old classmates very much.
redBlack.why: 黄12：very 不能直接压在动词上——「很想念」的 very much 放句尾。

redBlack.bad: She often forget to water the plants.（要不要当场纠正？）
redBlack.good: forgets——但灰区的错记在本上就行，别打断她说话。
redBlack.why: ⚪14：三单 -s 丢失意思零损失——官方满分范文里也有这类小错，照样拿满分。

redBlack.bad: Let's discuss about the plan and then return back the books.
redBlack.good: Let's discuss the plan and then return the books.
redBlack.why: ⚪16：discuss 和 return 词义里已含 about/back——冗余不挡意思，知道即可。

contrast.cn: 你喜欢音乐吗？（「吗」字报问意）
contrast.en: Do you like music?（助动词 + 语序报问意）
contrast.diff: 红1 的病根：中文问句靠句尾小词，英语靠句首手势——手势不打，问意丢失。

contrast.cn: 我很开心。（「很」直接接形容词）
contrast.en: I am very happy.（中间必须有 be）
contrast.diff: 红2 的病根：中文形容词自己能当谓语，英语的形容词必须挂在 be 上。

contrast.cn: 昨天他看见一只狗，跑了。（动词永远不变）
contrast.en: Yesterday he saw a dog and ran.
contrast.diff: 红3 的病根：中文动词没有日期戳，英语每个动词都要对表——而且全程对同一块表。

contrast.cn: 因为下雨，所以我们没去。（成对出现才舒服）
contrast.en: Because it rained, we didn't go.
contrast.diff: 黄8 的病根：中文「因为……所以」是标配套装，英语一句只发一个领队。

contrast.cn: 我很喜欢这首歌。（「很」压在动词前）
contrast.en: I like this song very much.（very much 收尾）
contrast.diff: 黄12 的病根：中文的「很」是万能强度词，英语的 very 只肯站在形容词副词前面。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 改错先问三句话：挡意思吗？考吗？都不？——红区立即改，黄区专项练，灰区记本别打断。
steps: 听到或写出一个错，先问：会让人误解或听不懂吗？会 → 红区（缺 be、缺助动词、时态跳、主被动反），当场改。
不挡意思，再问：考试考吗？考 → 黄区（介词、代词格、冠词、双重连词、从句语序、时态呼应、非谓语、very、There be），记进错题本，按对应课号回炉专项。
既不挡也不考 → 灰区（三单 -s、单复数、冗余表达），记录但绝不当场打断。
拿不准归哪区？默认灰区——宁可放过，不可错杀开口的勇气。
自查作文时反着用：先扫红区四类，再扫黄区，灰区最后顺手看一眼。
每类病都有主治的课——卡片上标了课号，哪类反复犯就回哪课重练一轮。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝的英语，我只管四件事。」这是给家长的总排练手册：孩子说英语或读作文时，只盯红区四类——① 问句开头有没有 Do/Did/Is 这类小词；② 形容词前有没有 is/am/was 的音；③ 讲昨天的事，动词是不是一路都是过去的调（听到 go、see 混进 went、saw 里就是跳了）；④ 「被」的事有没有 was/been 的音。这四类当场温和地提一句「再说一遍试试？」。黄区的错——介词、冠词这些——记在小本上，周末挑一类回对应的课练；灰区的错——go 没加 s、book 没加 s——只记不提。最要紧的一条：官方的满分作文里也有灰区小错，照样拿满分。纠错的目标不是完美，是让人听懂。孩子敢开口，比全对值钱。
questions: 红区四类是哪四类？为什么只有它们要当场改？
孩子说 He go to school by bike，你该打断吗？为什么？
拿不准一个错归哪区的时候，默认按哪个区处理？

sections.echo: 十六类毛病点完，五十课也到了终点。回头看这一路：be 收集了五副面孔，go 的过去式是借来不还的 went，good 的比较级是别家的 better，get、take、put 一个词攒下十几个意思，I 独享大写，were 独守虚拟的礼服——当初它们一个个冒出来的时候，都像是英语在故意刁难。但走完五十课再看，它们不是一堆乱七八糟的例外，而是同一条规律反复现身：越常用的词，被时间磨得越多，攒下的兼职越多，保住的老形态也越多。语言像一条河，水流最急的河心，石头被磨得最圆。往后再遇到任何一个「不规则」，都可以先问一句：是不是因为它太常用了？十有八九，是的。英语不是没有秩序——它的秩序，连例外都排得整整齐齐。总排练结束，灯光交给你。

memoryCard.alt: G50 记忆卡：中式英语 16 类三色总表。红区四类会挡意思当场改（疑问句缺助动词/缺be/叙事时态跳/主被动颠倒）；黄区九类不挡但考按专项练（介词/代词格/冠词/双重连词/从句语序/时态呼应/非谓语/very like/There has）；灰区三类只记不打断（三单-s/单复数/冗余），官方满分范文也有此类错照样满分；改错三问口诀；暗线终章：越常用的词磨得越圆。

questions.q: 16 类总表里，「红区」的判断标准是？
options: 会挡住意思——听的人误解或听不懂
questions.explain: 红区只看一条：意思传没传到。

questions.q: 红区一共几类？该怎么处理？
questions.explain: 缺助动词、缺 be、时态跳、主被动反——只有这四类值得当场改。

questions.q: 「不挡意思但考试要考」的是哪个区？
questions.explain: 黄区九类——为分数练，练熟即可。

questions.q: 灰区的错（三单 -s、单复数）该怎么处理？
options: 记在本上，绝不当场打断
questions.explain: 记录但不打断——反复纠灰区是把人说到不敢开口最快的办法。

questions.q: 官方满分范文里有没有灰区小错？
questions.explain: 满分标准是内容完整、意思清楚——不是零错误。

questions.q: You want some tea? 这个错归哪区？
questions.explain: 红1：不请 Do，问意送不出去。

questions.q: The classroom very big. 这个错归哪区？
questions.explain: 红2：等号 be 一丢句子散架。

questions.q: He play basketball after school. 这个错归哪区？
questions.explain: ⚪14：意思零损失——记本上就好。

questions.q: Because I was ill, so I stayed at home. 这个错归哪区？
questions.explain: 🟡8：意思照样懂，但考试爱考——去掉 so。

questions.q: The homework did by me last night. 这个错归哪区？
options: 红区——主被动颠倒/被动缺件
questions.explain: 红4：was done 的灯没换对——谁做谁挨全糊了。

questions.q: I very love my hometown. 这个错归哪区？
options: 黄区——very 不能直接压动词
questions.explain: 🟡12：意思能懂，但考试考——very much 放句尾。

questions.q: 拿不准一个错归哪区时，默认按哪个区处理？
options: 灰区——宁可放过，不可错杀
questions.explain: 错杀的代价是孩子不敢开口——默认从宽。

questions.q: There have many trees in the park. 病根是哪类？
options: 🟡13 There be 与 have 杂交
questions.explain: 报幕句式是 There are——不跟 have 焊在一起。

questions.q: 纠错的最终目标是？
questions.explain: 总排练的目标是观众听懂你要说的话。

questions.q: 黄区的错该怎么练最有效？
options: 按类回对应的课重练一轮
questions.explain: 每类病都有主治的课号——介词回 G11、从句语序回 G33。

questions.q: 这张 16 类总表和 KET 备考中心的 8 类表是什么关系？
options: 同一套三色逻辑，8 类升级成 16 类
questions.explain: 老表管 KET，新表加了进阶层暴露的 8 类新毛病——逻辑一脉相承。

questions.q: 想问同桌借不借你橡皮，哪句问意送得出去？
questions.explain: 红1 急诊：请 Did 起拍，语序到位。

questions.q: 「我爷爷八十岁了，身体很棒。」哪句 be 没丢？
options: My grandpa is eighty and he is very healthy.
My grandpa eighty and he very healthy.
My grandpa is eighty and he very healthy.
questions.explain: 红2 急诊：两个形容词前都要有 be。

questions.q: 讲昨天的事，哪句没在半路转调？
options: I woke up late, missed the bus and ran to school.
I woke up late, miss the bus and ran to school.
I wake up late, missed the bus and run to school.
questions.explain: 红3 急诊：三个动词一路都在过去格。

questions.q: 「蛋糕被吃光了。」哪句灯换对了？
questions.explain: 红4 急诊：was + eaten 两件套齐全。

questions.q: 「你妹妹会游泳吗？」哪句对？
questions.explain: 红1：情态动词自己会搬家提问（G17）——Can 提前。

questions.q: 「今天的汤有点咸。」哪句对？
options: The soup is a little salty today.
The soup a little salty today.
The soup very salty today, yes.
questions.explain: 红2：形容词 salty 必须挂在 is 上。

questions.q: 「上周我们参观了消防站，学到很多。」哪句对？
options: Last week we visited the fire station and learned a lot.
Last week we visit the fire station and learned a lot.
Last week we visited the fire station and learn a lot.
questions.explain: 红3：visited 和 learned 同站过去格。

questions.q: 「我的作文被老师表扬了。」哪句对？
options: My composition was praised by the teacher.
My composition praised by the teacher.
questions.explain: 红4：第三句意思全反——作文表扬了老师。

questions.q: 「他们昨晚为什么没来？」哪句对？
options: Why didn't they come last night?
Why they didn't come last night?
Why they not come last night?
questions.explain: 红1：疑问词后仍要倒——didn't they。

questions.q: 「这些饺子是外婆包的。」哪句对？
options: These dumplings were made by Grandma.
These dumplings were make by Grandma.
questions.explain: 红4：were + made——报时和状态牌都在。

questions.q: 「我小时候特别怕黑。」哪句对？
options: I was very afraid of the dark when I was little.
I very afraid of the dark when I little.
I was very afraid of the dark when I little.
questions.explain: 红2：主句从句两个 be 一个都不能少。

questions.q: 「弟弟打翻了牛奶，妈妈擦了地板。」哪句对？
options: My brother knocked over the milk, and Mum wiped the floor.
My brother knocks over the milk, and Mum wiped the floor.
My brother knocked over the milk, and Mum wipes the floor.
questions.explain: 红3：叙事两件事同一块表。

questions.q: 「你冷不冷？」哪句对？
questions.explain: 红1+红2：形容词问句请 be 搬家——不是 Do。

questions.q: 「教室每天放学后都有人打扫。」哪句对？
options: The classroom is cleaned after school every day.
The classroom cleans after school every day.
The classroom cleaned after school every day, always.
questions.explain: 红4：教室不会自己打扫——is cleaned。

questions.q: 「那时我不知道他的名字。」哪句对？
options: I didn't know his name then.
I don't knew his name then.
I not know his name then.
questions.explain: 红1 变体：否定也要请 did——didn't + 原形。

questions.q: 「演出很精彩，我们都站起来鼓掌了。」哪句对？
options: The show was wonderful, and we all stood up and clapped.
The show wonderful, and we all stood up and clapped.
The show was wonderful, and we all stand up and clap.
questions.explain: 红2+红3 联查：be 在场，动词全程过去格。

questions.q: 病句 We play football in Sunday afternoon. 主治方案是？
questions.explain: 🟡5 介词：具体某天的下午用 on——回 G11。

questions.q: 病句 Me and Lily water the flowers every day. 主治方案是？
options: Me and Lily → Lily and I
questions.explain: 🟡6 代词格：主语位用 I，对方在前——回 G03。

questions.q: 病句 My father is engineer. 主治方案是？
questions.explain: 🟡7 冠词：单数职业名词不能光着上台——an engineer，回 G02。

questions.q: 病句 Because he was tired, so he went to bed early. 主治方案是？
questions.explain: 🟡8 双重连词：领队只留一个——回 G20/G36。

questions.q: 病句 I wonder what time is it now. 主治方案是？
options: is it → it is（从句坐正）
questions.explain: 🟡9 从句语序：进座位要坐正——回 G33。

questions.q: 病句 She told me she will lend me the novel. 主治方案是？
questions.explain: 🟡10 时态呼应：主句过去，从句退一步——回 G40。

questions.q: 病句 They enjoy to play chess after lunch. 主治方案是？
questions.explain: 🟡11 非谓语：enjoy 只收箱——回 G46。

questions.q: 病句 I very enjoy the school trip. 主治方案是？
options: 改成 I enjoy the school trip very much.
questions.explain: 🟡12：very 不压动词——very much 收尾。

questions.q: 病句 There has a music room on the second floor. 主治方案是？
questions.explain: 🟡13：报幕句式用 There is——回 G05。

questions.q: 病句 My cousin is good at play the drums. 主治方案是？
questions.explain: 🟡11 变体：介词 at 后收箱——回 G46。

questions.q: 病句 We arrived Beijing in the morning of June 1st. 有几处黄区病？
options: 两处——arrived 后加 in，in the morning → on the morning
questions.explain: 🟡5 连环：arrive in + 具体某天早上用 on。

questions.q: 病句 Neither my parents or I likes horror films. 最要紧的黄区病是？
questions.explain: 🟡8 变体：配对连词别拆散——neither...nor（G20）。

questions.q: 病句 Could you tell me how can I get to the underground station? 主治方案是？
options: how can I → how I can
questions.explain: 🟡9：从句坐正——can 收回主语后面。

questions.q: 病句 The teacher asked us don't be late again. 主治方案是？
questions.explain: 🟡11 变体：ask sb not to do——否定的号嘴（G30/G46）。

questions.q: 病句 He said he has already saw that film the day before. 有几处黄区病？
options: 两处——has → had（呼应退步），saw → seen（第三形态）
questions.explain: 🟡10 连环：said 之前的事用 had seen。

questions.q: 病句 I look forward to see you in the summer holiday. 主治方案是？
options: see → seeing（这个 to 是介词）
questions.explain: 🟡11：look forward to 后装箱——回 G46。

stages.name: 用一用 · 当总排练指挥

questions.q: 弟弟说 He go to school by bike every day.——你该？
options: 不打断——三单 -s 是灰区，记在本上
questions.explain: ⚪14：意思零损失——打断的代价比错本身大。

questions.q: 同学说 My mother very angry yesterday.——你该？
options: 温和提醒——缺 be 是红区，当场改成 was very angry
questions.explain: 红2 当场改：形容词前必须有 be——这是四类之一。

questions.q: 作文自查的正确顺序是？
options: 先扫红区四类，再扫黄区九类，灰区最后看一眼
questions.explain: 先保「听得懂」，再保分数，最后顺手。

questions.q: 判断：I have two dog and a cat. 哪个说法准确？
options: 灰区错——意思全懂，不必当场纠
questions.explain: ⚪15 单复数：dogs 丢了 s——听的人照样明白。

questions.q: 判断：The thief caught by the police last night. 哪个说法准确？
options: 红区错——被动缺 was，小偷成了抓人的
questions.explain: 红4：was caught 的 was 丢了——谁抓谁全糊。

questions.q: 一句话里红黄同时出现：Yesterday he see a snake and he very scared. 先治哪个？
options: 都要治——see→saw（红3）、very scared 前补 was（红2）
questions.explain: 两处都是红区——时态跳 + 缺 be，一次改齐。

questions.q: Because our team lost, so everyone very sad. 这句红黄各几处？
options: 黄一处（去 so）+ 红一处（sad 前补 was）
questions.explain: 🟡8 双领队 + 红2 缺 be——分区诊断再下手。

questions.q: 妹妹兴冲冲讲完一段英语故事，里面有 3 个三单错、1 个单复数错。最好的反馈是？
options: 先夸她讲完整了，错记在本上改天练
questions.explain: 全是灰区——完整开口比零错误值钱得多。

questions.q: There have many old photos in the album, they very precious. 两处病分别是？
options: There have → There are（黄13）；very precious 前补 are（红2）
questions.explain: 杂交句式 + 缺 be——黄红各一。

questions.q: 写信开头 I very miss you. 该怎么升级？
options: I very much miss you very.
questions.explain: 🟡12：very much 收尾——「很想你」的正确落点。

questions.q: 口语里说 Let's return back to the topic. 准确的评价是？
options: 灰区冗余——能懂、几乎不考，知道 return 自带「回」即可
questions.explain: ⚪16：词义已含的成分重复——最轻的一类。

questions.q: 考场改错题给你一句：Tom said he will visit the museum where he can saw old coins. 改几处？
options: 两处——will → would（黄10）、can saw → can see（情态后原形）
questions.explain: 呼应退步 + 情态后原形——黄区连环但都不挡意思。

questions.q: 你当一天「小指挥」，红区口袋里该装哪四张便签？
options: 缺助动词、缺 be、时态跳、主被动反
questions.explain: 红区四类——只有它们会挡住观众的耳朵。

questions.q: 朋友作文得了高分但有两个 he go 式小错，他很沮丧。你该告诉他？
options: 满分范文里也有这类小错——内容完整意思清楚才是评分核心
questions.explain: 评分看的是把话说清楚——灰区小错不掩盖好文章。

questions.q: 16 类总表用了一年后，最理想的状态是？
options: 红区绝迹，黄区少见，灰区顺其自然减少
questions.explain: 分区推进——先保意思，再保分数，最后水到渠成。

questions.q: 大考：Yesterday I very tired, because I stay up late, so I sleep in class and the teacher criticize me. 红黄灰各几处？
options: 红 2 处（tired 前缺 was、stay/sleep 时态跳）+ 黄 1 处（because...so 双领队）+ 灰 1 处（criticize 该 criticized 属时态跳一并算红）
questions.explain: 先补 was（红2），再把 stay/sleep/criticize 全部对回过去表（红3），最后去掉 so（黄8）——总排练收官，一句点完三类。

detective.sentence: Because the film was boring, so we left early.
detective.fixed: Because the film was boring, we left early.
detective.clue: 🟡8 双重连词——because 和 so 一山不容二虎，领队只留一个。

detective.sentence: I very like the new song of our band.
detective.fixed: I like the new song of our band very much.
detective.clue: 🟡12 very 压动词——very 不能直接压在动词上，「很喜欢」的 very much 放句尾。

detective.sentence: Yesterday Tom tells me a joke and we laugh for a long time.
detective.fixed: Yesterday Tom told me a joke and we laughed for a long time.
detective.clue: 🔴3 叙事时态跳——昨天的事，动词一路都要在过去格。

detective.sentence: There has a big playground behind our teaching building.
detective.fixed: There is a big playground behind our teaching building.
detective.clue: 🟡13 There be 与 have 杂交——报幕用 There is，别跟 have 杂交成 There has。

detective.sentence: Could you tell me where is the nearest bus stop?
detective.fixed: Could you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?
detective.clue: 🟡9 从句语序——进了座位就要坐正，is 收回主语后面。

detective.sentence: She afraid of dogs when she was little.
detective.fixed: She was afraid of dogs when she was little.
detective.clue: 🔴2 be 缺失——形容词 afraid 必须挂在 was 上，等号不能省。

detective.sentence: The birthday cake ate by my little brother before the party.
detective.fixed: The birthday cake was eaten by my little brother before the party.
detective.clue: 🔴4 主被动颠倒——was 一丢，蛋糕成了吃东西的一方。

detective.sentence: Our monitor said she will collect the papers the next morning.
detective.fixed: Our monitor said she would collect the papers the next morning.
detective.clue: 🟡10 时态呼应——said 站在过去，从句的 will 跟着退成 would。
